title: Qwen3.8-27B UD-Q4_K_XL — RTX 4090 llama.cpp + z-lab DFlash2
slug_note: A single 24GB 4090 running 90 tok/s at ~30k context with DFlash2 block-diffusion drafting, and up to ~250k context with a 2-bit drafter.

variation.quant_detail: UD-Q4_K_XL (16.7GB); custom analogalok Q2_K (~700MB) DFlash2 drafter

engine.config: llama.cpp PR #27342 (DFlash2) with z-lab/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2 as the draft, run single-GPU with --parallel 1 to free VRAM for KV. Builder swapped the stock Q4_K_M draft for a custom 2-bit Q2_K drafter to unlock ~250k context.

requirements.notes: Peak VRAM 22.x GB of 24 at the 30k/n-max-4 point; --parallel 1 is required to free the batching reserve.

steps.text: Patch llama.cpp with PR #27342 (DFlash2) and build with CUDA
Download Unsloth UD-Q4_K_XL and the z-lab DFlash2 draft (optionally the 2-bit Q2_K drafter)
Serve with --spec-draft-n-max 4 and --parallel 1; KV q4_0/q8_0 depending on context

measurements.context: 30k context, DFlash2 n-max 4, 22.x GB VRAM; prefill 1,725 t/s
26k prompt baseline, custom 2-bit Q2_K drafter; Native MTP = 68.09 on the same box
26k prompt, DFlash2; MTP prefill 2,324 — a negative for DFlash2 (MTP wins prompt ingestion)
peak VRAM at the 30k / n-max-4 operating point

caveats: Multi-GPU tensor splitting and multimodality are broken on PR #27342 — this lane is single-GPU, text-only.
Native MTP beats DFlash2 on prefill (2,324 vs 1,662 tok/s); DFlash2 only wins decode.
The builder says "Q4_K_M" in the headline but pairs it with UD-Q4_K_XL; the checkpoint here is unsloth UD-Q4_K_XL.
Reproduced only by the builder; no independent run recorded.
